methods.description: For two non-zero factors or a dividend/divisor, use same signs for a positive result and different signs for a negative result, without calculating the whole answer.
For a multiplication/division chain, work from left to right, using each intermediate sign with the next number’s sign.
Find the sign of the known product and use the required final sign to decide whether the missing non-zero factor must have the same or different sign.
